blockedFoldersHelp: Every request under these folders is refused with 403, like an app's "deny from all" .htaccess. Installing an app fills this in. One folder per line.
blockedTypesHelp: Files with these extensions are refused with 403, like an app's <FilesMatch> deny. Write "log" for the whole site or "/modules/*.tpl" for one folder. Installing an app fills this in. One per line.
hiddenFilesNote: Hidden files and folders (.env, .git, .htaccess) are always refused; /.well-known/ stays public.
